Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square emblem for a project of the Olympuz family
Primary request: one square emblem that reads at a glance and stays readable when shrunk - many voices entering a bowl and leaving it as three carved lines.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column. Match the light, the material, the palette and the restraint of Image 1 exactly.
Subject: a single composition on a plain ivory ground: a shallow round white-marble oracular bowl standing on a low marble foot in the centre, five thin sky-blue threads running flat along the ground into its foot from the lower left, and three muted-gold bands rising from the bowl, curving right and ending flat inside three carved grooves on a small upright marble tablet at the right.
Composition/framing: perfect square, the composition centred with generous empty ivory margin on all four sides, nothing cropped, no column in this frame.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D marble and gold render, physically plausible materials, warm ivory Apple-like presentation
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, one gentle shadow under each object. Gold glows softly from within, never lit by a lamp or a hard rim light.
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, muted gold #C9A87A for the three bands and the bowl rim only, sky blue #B8D6EA for the ground threads only, charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints:
- Only three kinds of object in the frame: the bowl, the threads, the tablet with its bands. Nothing else.
- Five blue threads go in, exactly three gold bands come out, exactly three grooves are carved on the tablet.
- Every object rests on the surface and casts a shadow. Nothing hovers.
- The bowl is plain and smooth, with no engraving, no snakes and no flame inside it.
- The tablet face carries exactly three grooves and no writing.
- The shapes stay large and simple so the emblem survives being shrunk to a small icon.
- Preserve the reference style; highest final quality; maximum resolution.
Avoid: rainbow of many colors, prismatic colors, figures, faces, flames, smoke, tripod, snake, screens, keyboards, charts, bar graphs, pie charts, cables, brand marks, dark background, black background, neon, purple gradient, smoky cinema lighting, heavy bronze, metallic or plastic marble, watermark, callout labels
Text (verbatim): No readable text, no letters, no digits anywhere in the image.
